build_multitask_dataset: build a MultiTaskDataset from an annotation JSON file with data_root and data_prefix config
load_data_list: load and parse annotations from a JSON file into a list of data samples
prepare_data_sample: prepare a single data sample by applying the pipeline transforms to the indexed item
parse_data_info: parse raw annotation dict into structured data with img_path and gt_label fields
get_metainfo: get the merged meta information including tasks from class METAINFO and annotation file
